title: open detail from a drilled result row renders the detail surface
verifies: clicking a result row chevron opens the in-place detail view with a back header, field-anomaly profile, and Insights/JSON/Table tabs

title: back returns to the results list and keeps the drawer open
verifies: the back button restores the results list while the cell-explorer drawer stays open

title: JSON and Table tabs switch and render their content
verifies: the JSON and Table tabs render their content and the wrap toggle is only visible on the Table tab

title: prev/next steps between events and respects the position bounds
verifies: prev/next step between events, advance the position counter, and respect the first-event bound

title: copy link exposes a shareable URL with cell_event_ts
verifies: opening detail writes cell_event_ts to the URL and the copy-link button copies that URL to the clipboard

title: surrounding events section and window dropdown render and re-fetch
verifies: the surrounding-events section and window dropdown render and re-fetch on window change

title: deep-link reload restores the detail view via cell_event_ts
verifies: reloading a URL carrying cell_event_ts restores the detail view

title: Escape returns to the results list without closing the drawer
verifies: the Escape key returns to the results list while the drawer stays open

title: Table tab KV search filters the field list
verifies: the KV table search input narrows the field list to matching keys
